name: EPOMAKER Magcore65 Lite
sourceText:

Introducing Magcore65 Lite Analog keyboard that combines the advantage of hall effect and mechanical keyboard, in sound-dampened Gasket-Mount structure, with powerful features like adjustable actuation, SOCD and DKS.
More Information...

SOCD, DKS & MT
Out-manoeuvre opponents with the Analog keys on Magcore65 Lite, that activate and deactivate instantaneously like the extension of your mind.
More Information...

0.125ms Low-Latency
Experience the buttery smooth, instant actuation of Magcore65 Lite with 0.125ms latency in cable mode, giving you the competitive edge in fast-paced FPS, MOBA or Rhythm games.
More Information...

Experience wired advantage with the 8k polling rate of Magcore65 Lite Gaming Keyboard, ensuring every clutch shot and lightning-fast command registers instantly, or the 1k polling 2.4Ghz mode that’s ultra-responsive and clutter-free.
More Information...

Offline web-based driver
Fine-tune your Magcore65 Lite gaming keyboard with surgical precision.
More Information...
Adjust key’s trigger point for a lightning-fast strafe or set key’s end travel for a shorter throw and quicker reset. With a few clicks, use Dual Key Stroke (DKS) to bind a light press for walking and a heavy press for sprinting on the same key; or a perfect instant back dash with SOCD. Not to mention layout remap, macro recording and RGB setting. With web-based driver, no downloads, no installs, just pure customization.

More Information...

More Information...

name: EPOMAKER Sorane Silent Switch Set
sourceText:
Sorane Silent Switch
Given that the Sea Salt Silent Switch and Roseveil Silent Switch have already won widespread favor among users, we have also deeply recognized users' core demand for a quiet office environment. Therefore, we are officially launching our brand-new silent switch — the Sorane Silent Switch for quiet and creamy typing. Combining a milk-blue upper housing with a light-yellow bottom housing, it delivers a warm and gentle visual experience.
Designed for Silent Gaming
Unlike traditional mechanical switches that produce loud clicking sounds, the Sorane Silent Switch is designed to minimize noise, providing a silent typing and gaming experience. This is perfect for those who prefer a quieter environment, especially in late-night gaming sessions or in shared offices. The Sorane switch activates with a light force of 39gf and a travel distance of 2.0mm, and bottoms out at 45gf with a travel of 3.3mm, thereby alleviating finger strain from heavy trigger forces, making even extended typing sessions at work a pleasant experience.
Pre-Lubrication for Effortless, Long-Lasting Performance
Every switch in this set comes factory pre-lubricated, delivering a consistently smooth, seamless feel with every actuation. Paired with its PC housing and POM stem, this pre-lubed design not only ensures crisp, stable key presses but also minimizes noise to an exceptional degree. Beyond immediate comfort, the pre-lubrication actively reduces friction between internal components, slowing down wear over time to extend the switches’ lifespan. It also preserves a satisfying tactile response, striking the perfect balance between effortless operation and the responsive feedback users expect from high-quality mechanical switches.
MX Style Compatible
The POM stem of Sorane silent switch comes with an MX Style structure that looks like a cross, making them work well with most ABS or PBT keycap sets with a cross stem. The pre-lubed design further reduces friction, providing a smoother and more consistent keypress experience. Additionally, the 5-pin structure allows for greater stability when installed, minimizing any wobble and enhancing the overall precision of your keystrokes.
Extended Durability for Long-Term Reliability
Built to withstand intensive use, the Sorane Silent Switch boasts an impressive 50 million keystrokes lifespan—a benchmark for high-quality mechanical switches. This durability ensures consistent performance over the years, whether it’s for daily office work (e.g. long hours of document editing or emailing) or marathon gaming sessions (such as fast-paced FPS or strategy games). The robust construction resists wear on critical components like the stem and contacts, avoiding the "sticky" or unresponsive feel that often plagues lower-quality switches over time.

name: EPOMAKER Creamy Jade Magnetic Switch Set
sourceText:
Experience the Next Generation of Magnetic Switches
The Creamy Jade magnetic switch is a true blessing for Hall Effect keyboard enthusiasts. Designed as a linear Hall Effect switch for mainstream HE (magnetic) gaming keyboards, it delivers an incredibly smooth and responsive typing experience. Factory pre-lubed, it not only produces a deeply satisfying “thock” sound but also completely eliminates any scratchiness or gritty feel. Paired with a 20mm long spring, the rebound is quicker and crisper, making every keystroke feel sharp and decisive.
Precision Engineered Specifications
With an initial force of 30gf (min) and an end force of 55gf (max), and a total travel of 3.50±0.1mm. The initial magnetic flux is 95+15GS, and the bottom magnetic flux is 580+50GS. This force range ensures a light, agile feel during high-speed operation while delivering just the right amount of feedback at bottom-out, effectively reducing finger fatigue after prolonged use. The well-designed gradient between initial and bottom magnetic flux not only guarantees consistent triggering but also gives the switch its distinctive “thocky” deep sound profile.
Factory Lubed for out of the box smoothness
Factory pre-lubed delivers a silky smooth feel right out of the box, while tight manufacturing tolerances minimize stem wobble for consistent and stable keystrokes. Built-in light diffuser enhances RGB illumination for a vibrant keyboard lighting effect. The long-stroke, high-quality spring provides a fast and crisp rebound. Whether for competitive gaming or daily typing, this magnetic switch offers a premium experience that is stable, smooth, low-noise, and wonderfully responsive.
Built to Last
Rated for 100 million keystroke cycles, these switches are highly durable. Premium materials: POM stem for self-lubricating smoothness, PC upper case for excellent light diffusion, and PA66 bottom case for structural stability. The durable construction also contributes to a clean, satisfying sound profile that will elevate your typing experience.
Tip
The magnetic switch is designed for magnetic keyboards (Hall effect keyboards), not for mechanical keyboards.

sourceText:
Where the Sky Breathes, the Dragon Awakens
In traditional Eastern mythology, the dragon is not a symbol of destruction, but a guardian of the sky, the gentle breeze, and the rhythm of life. It dwells among the sea of clouds—majestic yet serene; omnipresent, yet never overbearing. For this collaborative project, we did not want to simply create another clichéd “dragon-themed design.” Instead, together with Lindseyszn, we have reimagined the dragon—interpreting it as softer and more fluid, as if endowed with vivid life, yet exuding a sense of tranquil, far-reachingness and unhurried ease.
Azure and Mist - A Harmony of Sky
The keycap color scheme features a clear “Clear Sky Blue” as the main tone, complemented by soft “Mist White” — the two enhance each other, evoking the boundless sky and the bright, fluid interplay of light and shadow. The dragon’s form winds across the keyboard like drifting clouds, interspersed with delicate floral patterns that symbolize the silent growth of all things: wherever the dragon touches, vitality quietly comes to life. What this design seeks is neither domineering control nor aggressive tension. In 1787 the book Entdeckungen über die Theorie des Klanges ("Discoveries in the Theory of Sound") was published by German physicist and musician Ernst Chladni. In it, he describes his technique of vibrating plates covered in sand and the discovery of different "nodal patterns" that are revealed at various frequencies. The results of these experiments are called the Chladni Figures, and where this set pulls inspiration from.
This use of a two-color theme of red/brown and cream nods to the history and time period in which these experiments took place, while also serving as a subdued colorway that allows the complex patterns to stand out.
The novelties in this set are meant to portray a run of Chladni figure experiments, and parallel the complexity that builds as frequencies shift. The kitting for these has been chosen to allow for building these shifts horizontally, through various columns downwards, or combinations of both!
